lead.why: Abstract: 'the most promising compound 38 could inhibit TAK1 kinase and NF-kB signaling pathway with the IC50 values of 0.58 and 0.84 uM'; also the compound of the cell-cycle, apoptosis and western-blot follow-ups.

reactions.conditions: Et3N, MeOH, 0 C (scheme: 12 h; text: amine added slowly, stirred 5 h), evaporate, wash with water, filter
reactions.source: Sec. 2.1 and 4.2 (general procedure for 8a-e); Scheme 1 step a

reactions.conditions: 4-aminophenol, NaOH (text: 'hydrogen sodium'), Na2CO3, H2O, 0 C 30 min; then 12c in THF added, 80 C, 6 h; column (CH2Cl2/MeOH 60:1)
reactions.source: Sec. 4.6 (general procedure for 14a-b and 14e from 12a-c); Scheme 1 step e

notes: The scheme is a drawing, so structures come from the text. (1) 12c is never described as prepared (12a,b are made from the aminothiophene acids; 12c only appears as a substrate in Sec. 4.6) and 14e is the N-methylpicolinamide aryl ether, so I take 12c = 4-chloro-N-methylpicolinamide and treat it as commercial. This identity is inferred, not printed. (2) Compound 8 for 38 is 2-chloro-4-(piperidin-1-yl)pyrimidine (8a-e are 4-substituted-2-chloropyrimidines from 2,4-dichloropyrimidine + amines a-e; the letter for piperidine is not stated; C4 regiochemistry per the paper's wording). (3) Names of 8, 12c and 14e are not printed (name ''); structures derived. (4) Step 2 conditions are garbled in the text ('hydrogen sodium'); the scheme legend lists sodium carbonate, sodium hydroxide, THF, 80 C, 6 h.
